verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly publish developer API documentation, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no interactive API reference and no runnable examples. The only API evidence is a keyless JSON endpoint served from the Socrata open-data platform (data.colorado.gov), which is a host-platform capability rather than a documented API reference from the registry itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
